name: Social Links
description: One place for the business's social profile URLs, printed as a list of links by a theme and available to other services such as Schema

setup.postInstallNote: Prints nothing until a link is saved on Content > Social Links. The 'social-links' hook is rendered in place by a theme (for example in its footer) with $template['serviceBlock']('social-links'); the markup is a plain list with a data-network attribute on each item for the theme to style. Other services read the saved URLs from this service's config context as $socialLinks['links'] without depending on it.
